description: The stream webhook request carries BOTH `notification_url` and `notificationUrl` wire keys (the API is mid-rename; the docs list both with the identical description). They camel-collide into `notificationUrl`/`notificationUrl2`. Keep ONE member bound to the camelCase wire key — the form v0 distilled used, runtime-verified, and the only one the response documents — and drop the snake_case duplicate.
